comments.author: Brent Royal-Gordon
comments.html:
> Apple contrasts this with the static allocation of disk space to support multiple HFS+ instances, which seems both specious and an uncommon use case.

Every Mac comes from the factory with two volumes: Macintosh HD and the recovery OS. It would not be a bad thing if they could share free space, or even share storage for identical files. That could remove most of the recovery volume's overhead.
